analysis.title_zh: 模型能否运行于 AWS Trainium？通过 torch-neuronx model support Space 查询
analysis.summary: 公告介绍 torch-neuronx model support Space，用于查询 Hub 热门模型能否不经修改运行于 AWS Trainium，并提供自行运行的脚本。其背景是原生 PyTorch 后端 TorchNeuron，使 Transformers 能在 Trainium 上运行自身建模代码。Space 默认展示 Selected 视图，模型依据下载量与趋势评分筛选，逐行列出运行结果及分片使用的 Trainium 核心数，适合模型兼容性初筛与迁移前核查；不能据此认定所有模型均已获得支持。
analysis.application: 建议：科研迁移时，可先查询候选模型的运行结果及分片核心数，再参考所提供脚本开展复现与资源评估。官方已明确的功能是兼容性结果查询和运行脚本提供；所给原文未提供具体模型测试结果、性能提升或成本优势，迁移收益仍需自行验证。
analysis.requirements: 原文涉及的运行平台为 AWS Trainium，后端为 TorchNeuron（torch-neuronx 包）；未明确版本、账号、API、费用或具体部署要求，使用条件见官方文档。

steps.text: 进入 Space 的默认 Selected 视图，查看按 Hub 下载量与趋势评分筛选的模型。
steps.evidence: The Space opens on the Selected view: our own selection of models picked among the top models on the Hub by downloads and by trending score.

evidence: we introduced TorchNeuron, the native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium (the torch-neuronx package).
With it, Transformers runs its own modeling code on Trainium, as it does on any other device, so any Transformers model on the Hub may run.
The torch-neuronx model support Space answers that question for the most popular models on the Hub.
It tells you whether a model runs unmodified on Trainium, and gives you the script to run it yourself.
The Space opens on the Selected view: our own selection of models picked among the top models on the Hub by downloads and by trending score.
